pairs.question: Quid sumus aut loquimur, vita est quid denique nostra?
pairs.answer: Vel modo nobiscum vixit homo, nunc homo non est.
pairs.derivation: Rhetorical question answered immediately by the next verse. Square-bracket line-break supplements deni[que and no[n stripped to denique and non, keeping the words. Answer ends at the full stop after 'homo non est'; what follows ('Stat lapis et nomen tantum...' and a second deflecting question 'Quid quasi iam vita est? Non est quod quaerere cures!') is not part of this answer and the later question is answered only by a deflection, so it is excluded.

pairs.question: Non dolor est, ut quem amas pereat?
pairs.derivation: Rhetorical consolation question answered by the following verse. The leading exclamatory interjection 'he.iu' (alas) is framing/cry, not part of the interrogative clause, so it is dropped and the first word capitalized. Answer is the single following verse; it is the last line of the epitaph, so nothing follows to trim.
